programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Big Bang
programme.desc: Throughout history, our nightly view of the universe has fueled our collective imagination. When it comes to the Big Bang, not even the most creative work of imagination can rival what science has revealed about the birth of the universe.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 1: The Solar System
programme.desc: This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 7: The Milky Way
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Sun
programme.desc: The sun bathes our planet in warmth and light. It powers the machinery of nature, our weather, and it encourages and sustains life on land and at sea. We study it closely, and it can reveal the secrets of all other stars.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Orbit
programme.desc: Chances are, you are watching this program by satellite, one way or the other. Every day we use these wonders of human design, from communication and weather observation, to GPS and recourse management.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Sling Shot
programme.desc: Soviet Luna 3 was the first to use gravity to change course to photograph the dark side of the Moon. NASA Mariner 10 used the technique to swing by Venus to target Mercury. The gravity sling shot maneuver has become a standard for space navigation.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 3: Asteroids
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 6: Fermi paradox
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: How to Colonize the Stars: The Challenge of Interstellar Flight
programme.desc: Leading physicists and engineers in the field of interstellar travel discuss some of the deep issues we face when considering the problem of sending spacecraft to other stars. Will mankind ever truly become a space fairing civilization?

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.sub-title: Hidden Havens: Icy Moons / Icy Gems: Frozen Moons
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Fermi Paradox
programme.desc: The Fermi Paradox asks the ultimate question: Given a few reasonable assumptions about the chance of life arising elsewhere in the universe and the distance between the stars, why has an alien civilization not presented itself?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 2: Moons
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 5: Space Missions
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.sub-title: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage: Earthrise: The First Lunar Voyage
programme.desc: Interviews with Apollo 8 astronauts, their wives, mission control staff, and journalists give true insider's perspective to the space race of the late 1960's.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity keeps us on the ground and the planets in their orbits, yet we only notice it when it's not there. In space we cheat gravity; falling just as fast but missing the ground. Now this fundamental universal force is slowly giving up its secrets.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.sub-title: Windows to Other Worlds / Fountain of Creation
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Virtual Universe
programme.desc: Our understanding of the cosmos is limited by the amount of time we have to see it. Fortunately, computer simulations can help us see how galaxies interact over millions of years, and even how dark matter structures the universe.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.sub-title: Project Gemini Advances, Cassini at Saturn & More About Mars
programme.desc: Project Gemini Advances - NASA refines the techniques needed for rendezvous. Cassini at Saturn - In the Cassini probe's final years of activity, its handlers are asking it to do more complex and risky assignments.

programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space: Episode 8: Extravehicular Activity
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see.

programme.sub-title: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.desc: Simi Jan fortæller om mad i Shaolin-templet, sin pakistanske mors køkken og studietiden i Skotland. Hun har smagt sig gennem det meste af verden – og afslører selvfølgelig også sin guilty pleasure!

programme.title: Sniper 2
programme.desc: On one last mission, Thomas Beckett is sent into a remote, war-torn wasteland between Eastern Europe and Western Asia to assassinate a repressive terrorist leader. Once the mission is accomplished, Beckett and his spotter, Cole, find escaping more difficult than anticipated. In order to save their lives, Beckett and Cole must weave their way through burnt-out cities and desolate landscapes.

programme.title: Sniper 3
programme.desc: Master Gunnery Sergeant Thomas Beckett has over seventy confirmed kills in his long and illustrious career. The US Marine Corps most decorated sniper has taken out warlords, drug lords, assassins and bitter foes. This time, he's going after a friend.

programme.title: The Fog
programme.desc: One hundred years after their ship was deliberately wrecked, the ghosts of the murdered seaman have returned to Antonio Bay to exact a ghastly vengeance.

programme.title: Thunderheart
programme.desc: An engrossing suspense thriller based on actual events, THUNDERHEART stars Val Kilmer as an FBI agent with Sioux indian ancestry who is sent to a South Dakota indian reservation to capture a radical native American protester. As Kilmer struggles to get in touch with his own heritage, he begins to discover that the U.S. government has framed an innocent man.

programme.title: Snake In The Eagle's Shadow
programme.desc: SNAKE IN THE EAGLE'S SHADOW is the kung fu comedy masterpiece starring superstar Jackie Chan (RUSH HOUR, SHANGHAI NOON).

programme.title: Sinbad And The Eye Of The Tiger
programme.desc: The most ambitious of Ray Harryhausen's fabled Sinbad trilogy. When an evil sorceress turns a handsome prince into a baboon, Sinbad (Patrick Wayne) sets sail on a dangerous quest to break the witch'sspell. Co-starring Jane Seymour.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: Deep-sea divers vie with a Haitian drug dealer to recover a trunkload of sunken morphine. Based on Peter Benchley's best-selling novel.

programme.title: The Man Who Would Be King
programme.desc: John Huston directed this classic Kipling adventure about British soldiers trying to bamboozle high priests in remote Kafiristan.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Lawrence Of Arabia
programme.desc: Winner of seven Academy Awards(r), including Best Picture (1962), this is the restored director's cut of the breathtaking masterpiece.

programme.title: Berry Gordy's The Last Dragon
programme.desc: Martial arts student, Leroy Green (Taimak), is on a quest to obtain the elusive all-powerful force known as "The Glow." Along the way, he must battle the evil, self-proclaimed Shogun of Harlem - a kung-fu warrior also known as Sho'nuff (Julius J. Carry III) - and rescue a beautiful singer (Prince protegee, Vanity) from an obsessed record promoter.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Superfly
programme.desc: Superfly -the film that helped define a genre in its characters, look, sound, and feel -is reimagined with Director X, director of legendary music videos (Drake, Rihanna), introducing it to a new generation. The screenplay is by Alex Tse.

programme.title: Dirty (2006)
programme.desc: Hard-edged story of a gangbanger turned cop who is forced to choose between his conscience and his loyalty to the code of blue all in the course of one day.

programme.title: The Shepherd (2008)
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme stars in this hard-hitting action thriller about a border patrol agent who attempts to take down a rogue American Special Forces unit that's smuggling Afghan heroin into the United States.

programme.title: Kung Fu Hustle
programme.desc: KUNG FU HUSTLE perfectly blends original comedy and explosive martial arts action. Creative and imaginative characters slam together in a comic blend of Quentin Tarantino meets Jackie Chan in a filmthat goes beyond the limits of mere comedy.

programme.title: Robin and Marian
programme.desc: Sean Connery and Audrey Hepburn star as the legendary lovers Robin Hood and Maid Marion, who reunite twenty years after their first meeting. Now the mother superior of a nunnery, Marion finds herselfdrawn to a somewhat less agile Robin Hood when he returns from a lengthy Crusade in the Holy Lands.

programme.title: Sheena (1984)
programme.desc: Exotic Tanya Roberts stars as Sheena, a comic book legend that comes to life. As a child, she was lost in the African jungle and adopted by the Zambouli tribe. She rules over the untamed wilds of Africa, until outsiders challenge her domain in this exotic action-adventure.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Gloria (1980)
programme.desc: Rowlands garnered an Oscar nomination for her fierce portrayal as an ex-mob mistress who takes care of a young boy after his family is wiped out by the Mafia. Gloria must rely on all her street-savvy to prevent both herself and the boy from being the mobster's next target.

programme.title: And Justice For All
programme.desc: Al Pacino portrays a hot-shot lawyer looking for justice in a justice system run amok.

programme.title: Against All Odds (1984)
programme.desc: A dangerous love triangle develops when a shady nightclub owner hires an ex-football player to findhis runaway girlfriend.

programme.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger Hidden Dragon is a timeless story that takes place in feudal China when miracles were credible and spirits and gods were present in man's world. It is not unbelievable that zen warriors float through the air, skim the water and battle in trees and on rooftops. Pain, revenge and duty are the stuff that bind us in this world and are the main plot line of the movie, but in the afterlife love and faith linger on.

programme.title: Priest (2011)
programme.desc: A vampire western about a warrior priest who disobeys church law by teaming with a young sheriff and a priestess to track down a band of renegade vampires who have kidnapped his niece. An adaptation of the action-horror TokyoPop comic book.

programme.title: See no Evil, Hear no Evil
programme.desc: One of the looniest pictures to come along in some time! STIR CRAZY teams two of the most brilliant and zany comic performers today: Richard Pryor and Gene Wilder. Skip (Wilder) and Harry (Pryor) have both been fired from their jobs, so they take off in their van for California to seek fame and fortune, but somewhere along the way the van conks out and they're broke and...well, they have to eat, right? So they land a gig as singing and dancing woodpeckers to promote a bank opening. When two bank robbers steal their costumes and stick up the bank, guess who gets the blame? Skip and Harry are carted off to the state pen for 125 years. They try to keep their sanity and their lives amidst: a sadistic warden, a hulking mass-murderer and an inter-prison rodeo - all with great hilarity.

programme.title: Seems Like Old Times
programme.desc: In Neil Simon's SEEMS LIKE OLD TIMES, Chevy Chase is forced to abet some bank robbers, and soon the cops are after him. His ex-wife, Goldie Hawn, is a liberal lawyer married to the local district attorney. When Chase arrives at their home seeking shelter, she takes him in and their passions are rekindled.

programme.title: Ishtar
programme.desc: With a song in their hearts, the CIA on their backs, a gorgeous revolutionary in their arms and two nations after their heads, Warren Beatty and Dustin Hoffman find adventure, romance and comedy on the road to ISHTAR. Isabelle Adjani is the female lead and Elaine May is the writer and director.

programme.title: Another You
programme.desc: ANOTHER YOU is the uproarious slapstick comedy about a pathological liar who, upon his release from a mental clinic, becomes involved with a con man and ends up impersonating a billionaire. Scam follows double-scam in classic Pryor/Wilder style. Features Academy Award winner Mercedes Ruehl as a con who falls for Gene Wilder.

programme.title: Robin Hood: Men In Tights
programme.desc: Mel Brooks brings you the movie event of the summer--the summer of 1125--and the 12th century will never be the same. In days of old, when men were men, men wore tights. And none wore tights mightier than Robin Hood, the 12th century hero of Sherwood Forest. Aided by his band of merry men, Robin of Loxley (Cary Elwes) wrested power away from the evil Prince John (Richard Lewis), brought humiliation upon the despicable Sheriff of Rottingham (Roger Rees), and found the key to the fair Maid Marian's (Amy Yasbeck) heart as well as her Everlast Chastity belt.

programme.title: Man Of The House (2005)
programme.desc: A hard-edged Texas Ranger is forced to go undercover as an assistant cheerleading coach to protect a group of college cheerleaders after they witness a murder.

programme.desc: A late-night talk show host suspects that she may soon be losing her long-running show.

programme.desc: The end of the world is coming...and it's going to be hilarious.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes (2000)
programme.desc: Best friends and neighbors, Ryan Woodman and Maggie Carter, are four weeks away from the prom, and they've agreed to go together if they don't have real dates. Then Chris, a cool guy from the football team, offers to help Ryan connect with Ashley, a popular blond. In exchange, a la Cyrano, Chris needs Ryan's help to get close to Maggie. Ryan makes the deal, helps the dastardly Chris play Maggie, takes advantage of Ashley's lack of self-esteem, loses his values, makes fun of his geeky friends, and falls in Maggie's estimation. Maggie is fooled by Chris, poised to be his next score. Before prom night is over, with its Titanic theme, will Ryan stop sinking?

He pays a visit to a psychiatrist, Marianna (Julie Andrews), in the hope of removing a creative block he's been experiencing; instead, he falls for her and she for him.

programme.title: The Lobster
programme.desc: A love story set in a dystopian near future where single people are arrested and transferred to a creepy hotel. There they are obliged to find a matching mate in 45 days. If they fail, they are transformed into an animal and released into the woods.

Meanwhile, after learning of the misunderstanding, Fred has a change of heart only to find that Stacy has moved on.

Meanwhile, as Jane is surprised by Owen's disregard for the institution of marriage, Parker is called on to defend his son's elementary school teacher after he's suspended for appearing in a pornographic film. And after Teri helps drum up some business for Stacy by falsely claiming that the Pakery has some celebrity customers, she demands to be made President of Marketing. To keep Leela in the country, Jane gets the hearing transferred to the Bhutanese Consulate, which forces her to argue the case within that country's arcane judicial system. Even though Jane catches Prince Sanjay lying about Leela's trip to the United States, the Bhutanese judge ends the trial and orders her immediate deportation. However, with some help from an immigration court judge, Jane has the prince charged with human trafficking, giving Leela the asylum she's seeking. Meanwhile, after persuading a judge that teacher Greg Hillman's due process rights have been violated, Kim and Parker are given only a few hours to prepare before going to trial. And as Kim discovers that it was the principal who turned in Greg after seeing his X-rated videos, Teri's claims about the Pakery get some unwanted attention from the city. After forcing the principal to admit that he'd seen the videos several months before taking any action, Parker is jailed for contempt after stripping off his clothes in the courtroom in order to make the point that Greg shouldn't be punished for something he did legally years before becoming a teacher. programme.title: The Nanny
programme.desc: Though excited to learn that she will be working on Christmas Day, Fran is surprised to hear that Maxwell will be producing a benefit in Washington D.C. Told that the Sheffields will celebrate Christmas one day early, Fran is further disappointed to find that Maxwell farms out all of his gift buying to a personal shopper. So, upon finding that the children don't believe in Santa and that what Grace really wants is to have her father home on Christmas, Fran decides to have a talk with Maxwell -- until Niles points out that he is preparing the staff s Christmas bonuses. Revealing that C.C. will also be joining him in Washington but insisting that their trip will be all business, Maxwell is nonetheless persuaded to do his own shopping for a change. So, when Fran relies on Niles' assessment of her bonus and buys the children some expensive gifts, she discovers that, instead of money, Maxwell bought her a beautiful vase. Faced with having to either take back her gifts or somehow pay the bill, Fran declines Niles' offer of a loan and goes to see Val's Uncle Paulie to pawn the vase. But, when Maxwell mentions it later, Fran guiltily rushes to buy it back and, forced to pay twice what she got, sells her grandmother's watch instead. Receiving a call from Niles with word about Fran and the watch, Maxwell decides to make things right. So, leaving C.C. behind at the airport, he intercepts the family at St. Patrick's Cathedral and finds Fran in a confessional seeking help with her financial difficulties. Finally, after returning the watch and then accidentally sitting on the vase, Maxwell ends up at the hospital being treated for his wounds, while Grace gets her wish and renews her belief in Santa Claus.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Sabrina, Kelly and Kris invade the world of illusion to help a flame-throwing magician prove he is not the arsonist burning down fashion centers wherever he appears in "Magic Fire. Aging illusionist Wendell Muse is being hassled by cops across the land because suspicious fires keep breaking out in cities he plays. To clear his name, Muse hires the Angels, who bring their own bag of tricks to the caper. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kidnapers stalk Sammy Davis Jr., so Sabrina, Kelly and Kris are hired to protect him in "The Sammy Davis Jr. Kidnap Caper," guest starring Sammy Davis Jr. in twin roles as himself and as a guy who looks just like him, on "Charlie's Angels." The Angels become Sammy's bodyguards after an attempt has been made to snatch the superstar from the restroom of a restaurant. But when Sammy's look-alike -- an abrasive character named Herbert Brubaker III -- comes to visit Davis and his wife Altovise at their home, the kidnappers strike again, abducting Brubaker by mistake. The Angels set out to rescue Brubaker, who has his captors convinced he is the real Sammy, despite a hilarious "demonstration" of his talent. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Several people travel by bus to the Sunwest Dude Ranch, and when they arrive one of them is dead. The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

The man, identified as Joseph Frisch, was clubbed over the head, and one of the other passengers must be guilty because the bus, made no stops. Charlie's Angels arrive at the ranch shortly after, pretending to be three innocent visitors. By flirting with each of the suspects, they try to figure out what happened. George Jackson is known as an unscrupulous private eye, and the Angels watch him carefully since whatever he is doing is probably connected with the crime. Jean Trevor, another passenger, is romantically involved with Ed Miller, and E Cole is a sullen man who says very little, but the Angels can find no con-nection between these people and Joseph Frisch. Then Charlie learns of a big real estate swindle several years ago involving all of the passengers on the bus. Miss Trevor has stated that she did not know Frisch, yet they worked together. The link is supplied when the man who died o the bus is found to be not Frisch, but Ed Miller. The real Frisch, trying to \avoid being found, killed him and took his wallet and this is the man George Jackson is being paid to find. Jackson makes a telephone call, and that afternoon two new visitors arrive, Sloan and Farrell. When they realize their plan to kill Frisch is known, they try to escape, but all the roads have been blocked. Quickly, they take two horses, and there is no way for the Angels to capture them without doing the same. Kris, Kelly and Sabrina all ride beautifully in an exciting chase. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kris enters the ladies' "Hermosa Cup" tennis tournament when a series of unexplained accidents" leaves one of the stars dead and the others too frightened to play. First, a young player, Sandy, is locked in the showers and almost scalded to death, and then Helga, a health nut, finds a rattlesnake in her bag while meditating. Sabrina and Kelly come along, of course, and both go to work sweet-talking several males who are possible suspects. Ronny Kane is an unpleasant old woman--hater, but he seems basically harmless. Then there is Arlo Spinner, tennis supplies dealer, who has the pathetic ambition of being more successful than his father. Arlo was always the smallest kid on the block, as he confides to his new friend, Sabrina. (She and Kelly look ravishing in the tennis dresses Arlo wants them to model.) Another of the stars, Carrie Jo Evans, is one of the only healthy players remaining, and she just happens to be the main promoter of Arlo's racquets. She doesn't sus-pect a thing, however, until she overhears a, conversation that reveals all. Arlo has been trying to eliminate the competition so that Carrie, using his products, will win and bring prestige to his company. But Carrie will have nothing to do with it, and Arlo must leave in a great hurry, with the Angels not far behind. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: "Suspicious" is the only word for Dr. Franklyn Perine, former astronaut Jim Britten, and their "Celestial Research Foundation," in which rich contributors are promised life in outer space, flying saucers which have arrived on earth, and other wonders, in exchange for a huge amount of money. When one wealthy lady goes into the desert with Dr. Perine and is not heard from again, the Angels must cleverly sneak into a meeting to investigate. Bosley and Kris get in easily as a rich sugar daddy and his sexy playmate. Kelly entices Britten into giving her flying lessons as well as an invitation see the space show, while Sabrina claims to be a private detective checking one of the other members. When the "doctor" tells Kris that people from outer space are very free about matters of sex, and pressures hereto begin practicing immediately, the Angels waste no time an exposing the operation as a fraud. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: When someone tries to kill radio newswoman Joy Vance, the station naturally turns to Charlie and Company for help. The Angels' strategy is for Kelly to take over Joy's duties for a while, since their voices are similar, and for Kris and Sabrina to investigate the threats Joy has recently received. In the course of her work Joy frequently makes enemies, and one of these is probably the killer. Buck Willis, the radio station's helicopter pilot, hates Joy because she is more successful than he is. Sabrina flies with him doing the "air report," and finds him to be a man capable of violence. Dwayne Hanson, whose lifestyle is modeled after Charles Manson, believes he went to jail because Joy's reporting prejudiced a jury against him. Kris visits Dwayne and his "family" in the desert, but is not treated with great warmth hen they find out she isn't really a hippie. The last suspect is Professor Croyden, whose discovery of a cold vaccine was exposed by Joy as a fake. Croyden is known to be a skier, and the man who tried to kill Kelly (posing as Joy) was wearing a ski mask. Also, the license plates on the killer's car reveal that it was stolen that morning - from a student at Croyden's college - so Sabrina, who has just applied to be his assistant, may be in more trouble than she realizes. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Kelly's old friend, Tommy Anders, thinks his fiancée, Marie, has deserted him, and he leaves his Army post without permission. Actually she is about to have his child, but rather than force him to marry her, she has decided to sell the baby on the black market. This decision gets her involved with Hugh Tomlinson and his bodyguard, Chaffey, of the Warfield Home for Girls. Pregnant girls are tricked into giving up their babies and kept as prisoners -- and that isn't the worst of it. After Tommy comes to the Angels for help, a girl, last seen driving away with Chaffey is discovered -- dead. In order to infiltrate the horrible "home for girls," Sabrina and Bosley pretend be a wealthy, childless couple willing to pay for a baby, Kelly pretends to pregnant, and Kris pretends that she is willing to become a "baby-maker" for the home because the is desperately in need of money. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Enrico Mancini's musical production is not going well. Ellen and Frank Jason, who starred in the show twenty years ago would be perfect for it now, but their marriage went bad and they dislike each other too much to work together. Frank, however, is in debt, and by having two brutes follow him around to remind him of that, Mancini hopes to pressure Frank into taking the job. Anton Metzger presents a different kind of problem, and it is to find him that the Angels are hired. Anton is now deranged and mute, but many years ago he was in love with another lady who performed this show in Europe, and he is determined to prevent anyone else from doing it. He haunts the rehearsals, dropping heavy objects from to terrify the crew. But no one even knows what he looks like, and he always disappears without a trace. Frank and Kris become very fond of each other, and since Kris did some acting in college, Frank says he will do the show, but only if Kris is his leading lady. They do an impressive song together, with Anton dreaming of his old love as he watches above. Ellen also performs a beautiful song, and Frank is so moved when he hears it that the two of them decide their marriage can still be saved. Kate Jackson, Jaclyn Smith. and Cheryl Ladd star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Kelly Garrett and Kris Munroe, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophis-ticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

Samma kväll slår flera bilister larm om att Tishko vandrar längs E6 i beckmörkret. I lägenhete...

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 603
programme.desc: Izabell berättar för första gången om förlossningen och om de ödestunga minuterna. Luma berättar varför hon väljer att ha slöja, och Fayme har svårt att sluta amma dottern Mila, två år.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 604
programme.desc: Ellinor och Jimmy anlitar en expert på barnsäkerhet för att se vilka faror som finns i deras nybyggda hem. Sonia försöker få Daisy att sluta använda napp. Natalie avslöjar vad hennes nya dröm är.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 605
programme.desc: Faymes son Colin har en selektiv ätstörning och Fayme försöker spåna fram idéer på mat tillsammans med honom. Luma berättar om när hon träffade sin man som 16-åring. Izabell tar ett graviditetstest.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 606
programme.desc: Natalie, Richard och barnen leker i parken och Natalie avslöjar att Richard ska adoptera hennes tre barn. Ellinor och Jimmy ska ta med Aaron på sin första utlandsresa. Sonia tar med barnen till IKEA.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 607
programme.desc: Luma ska fota familjebilder i parken och tycker synd om fotografen. Izabell ger sig i kast med att laga egen mat till Domeniq. Fayme städar med barnen och lär dem att plocka undan efter sig.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 608
programme.desc: Natalie försöker få Cornelia att sluta amma. Ellinor berättar om relationen med Jimmy, och han förbereder en överraskning till henne för att ge henne uppskattning. Sonia tar med barnen ut på parklek.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 609
programme.desc: Izabell berättar om att hon mötte sin fästman på grund av att han var storebror till hennes bästa kompis. Fayme är och badar med Leo. Luma och barnen fixar fint i trädgården.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 610
programme.desc: Ellinor går med sonen Aaron på event och berättar om hur hon fått kämpa under uppväxten för att få leva det liv hon gör idag. Sonia lär Daisy att cykla och Natalie inreder lekstugan.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 611
programme.desc: Izabell är gravid och låter sonen Domeniq avslöja hennes graviditet för fästmannen. Fayme tar med barnen på second hand, och Luma vill att barnen ska börja sporta och tar med dem på tennis.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 612
programme.desc: Sonia berättar om när hon blev gravid och om skadorna hon fick under första förlossningen. Natalie lär Richard att rida på deras häst, och Ellinor och Jimmy försöker få vardagen att gå ihop.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 613
programme.desc: Luma åker med familjen till Istanbul för att operera näsan. Izabell berättar om hennes morfar som satt 30 år i finskt fängelse. Fayme och Moltas firar fyraårig bröllopsdag och drar iväg utan barnen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 614
programme.desc: Ellinor har haft astma hela hennes liv men trotsar den för att testa en ny typ av träningsform. Sonia går på treårskontroll, har kalas för Lily och reflekterar över hur underbart det är att ge liv.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 615
programme.desc: Luma vaknar upp efter näsoperationen och blir förälskad i sin nya näsa, frågan är vad familjen kommer tycka? Izabell tar med Domeniq för ettårsvaccination.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 616
programme.desc: Natalies stress har blivit allvarligare. Det är dags att varva ned och hon tar med familjen på spa. Aaron ska döpas och Ellinor är nervös då hon känner att hon inte har full koll.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 617
programme.desc: Fayme poddar med grannen och vännen Natashja. Luma har anställt en städare men tycker att det är respektlöst att titta på och börjar städa hela huset tillsammans med städaren.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 618
programme.desc: Ellinor skapar en lekhörna till Aaron, eftersom gården inte är speciellt barnvänlig. Natalie försöker få Alicia att överkomma sin rädsla för att hoppa upp på häst. Sonia tar med barnen till Skansen.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 619
programme.desc: Luma lovordar förorten i Malmö där hon växte upp och tar dit barnen för en nostalgitripp. Mila är i åldern då man rymmer ofta och Fayme tvingas försöka sätta upp hönsnät för att hon inte ska smita.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 620
programme.desc: Ellinor gör en youtubevideo där hon jävlas med Jimmy, och uttrycker hur tacksam hon är över vad livet givit henne. Natalie har köpt ytterligare en bil, och Sonia tar med familjen ut i skärgården.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Vi träffar alla mammor och deras barn för första gången. Natalie som har tre döttrar, tre hästar, åtta hundar och en stor gård har svårt att få ihop vardagen och ofta slutar läggningarna i kaos.

programme.title: Constantine
programme.desc: Demonien metsästäjä John Constantine taistelee uutta ei-tästä-maailmasta-tulevaa vihollista vastaan tässä silmät avaavassa yliluonnollisessa trillerissä ja joka sijoittuu Enkelten kaupunkiin, missä henkimaailman rajat ovat rikkoutuneet ja helvetti on pääsemässä irti. Aseistettuna krusifiksistä muotoillulla haulikolla ja pelottoman poliisin avustamana John Constantine, henkimaailman taistelija, käy apokalyptiseen sotaan. Ole hyvilläsi, että hän on sinun puolellasi. Amerikkalainen kauhu vuodelta 2005.

programme.title: One Shot
programme.desc: Yrittäessään estää Washingtoniin kohdistetun terrori-iskun on luutnantti Blake Harrisin (Scott Adkins) johtaman eliittisotilasjoukon noudettava yksi vangeista pahamaineiselta CIA:n vankileiriltä. Konflikti räjähtää käsiin, kun apulaispäällikkö Tom Shields (Ryan Philippe) kieltäytyy luovuttamasta vankia. Kapinallisten yllättäen hyökättyä salaiseksi oletetulle vankileirille on heidän kuitenkin luotettava toisiinsa ja taisteltava rinta rinnan selviytyäkseen ja pelastaakseen maansa pääkaupungin. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2021.

programme.title: Terminal
programme.desc: Rönsyilevän, anonyymin kaupungin synkässä sydämessä tapahtuva TERMINAL seuraa kahden palkkamurhaajan mutkaista polkua, tappavan taudin kourissa olevaa opettajaa (Simon Pegg), arvoituksellista vahtimestaria (Mike Myers) ja uteliasta tarjoilijaa (Margot Robbie), joka elää vaarallista kaksoiselämää. Murhaavat seuraukset paljastuvat yön syvyyksissä, kun kaikkien elämät kietoutuvat yhteen arvoituksellisen rikollisneron käsissä. Joku hautoo kostoa. Trilleri vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Jurassic World: Kaatunut valtakunta
programme.desc: On kulunut kolme vuotta siitä, kun teemapuisto ja luksuslomakohde Jurassic World tuhoutui dinosaurusten päästyä valloilleen. Isla Nublar on hylätty ja hävityksestä selviytyneet dinosaurukset elävät villeinä viidakoissa. Kun saaren uinuva tulivuori alkaa näyttää elonmerkkejä, Owen ja Claire aloittavat kampanjan, jonka tarkoituksena on pelastaa dinosaurukset uuden sukupuuton uhalta. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: Katu-uskottava varas Nathan Drake (Tom Holland) värvätään kokeneen aarteenmetsästäjä Victor “Sully” Sullivanin (Mark Wahlberg) toimesta hankkimaan takaisin Fernão de Magalhãesin 500 vuotta sitten kadottamat rikkaudet. Ryöstökeikkana alkaneesta tehtävästä tulee maailmanlaajuinen jännittävä takaa-ajo, kun kaksikko yrittää saada palkkion ennen häikäilemätöntä Moncadaa (Antonio Banderas), joka uskoo olevansa perheineen laillinen perijä. Jos Nate ja Sully voivat selvittää johtolangat ja ratkaista yhden maailman vanhimmista mysteereistä, heillä on mahdollisuus löytää viiden miljardin arvoinen aarre ja ehkä jopa Naten kauan sitten kadonnut veli... mutta vain, jos he oppivat tekemään yhteistyötä. Amerikkalainen toimintaseikkailu vuodelta 2021.

programme.title: I Spy
programme.desc: Alex Scott on tiedusteluagentti, jonka tehtävänä on hankkia takaisin kaapattu näkymätön vakoilukone. Scott kuulee, että takkinsa kääntänyt agentti on myynyt koneen Arnold Gundarsille, säälimättömälle asekauppiaalle. Scott menettää yhden tilaisuuden napata Gundars rysän päältä, mutta hän kuulee Gundarsin olevan nyrkkeilyfani. Niinpä Scott palkkaa keskisarjan mestarinyrkkeilijän Kelly Robinsonin, jolla on vielä saavutuksiaankin suurempi ego. Amerikkalainen toimintakomedia vuodelta 2002.

programme.title: American made
programme.desc: Kansainvälinen tositapahtumiin perustuva toimintaelokuva, joka kertoo yhdestä Yhdysvaltain historian suurimpaan peiteoperaatioon värvätystä huijarista ja lentäjästä. American Made on CIA:n salaisuuteen pohjautuva muistutus siitä, ettei rikosta lasketa, jos sen tekee hyvien nimissä. Amerikkalainen toimintaelokuva vuodelta 2017.

programme.title: Maailman ympäri 80 päivässä
programme.desc: Herrasmies Fog lyö vetoa, että hän pystyy kiertämään maapallon 80 päivässä. Palvelijansa Passepartoun ja tämän parhaan ystävän Tikon kanssa Fog ajautuu moniin jännittäviin seikkailuihin. Amerikkalainen draama vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Captive State
programme.desc: Kun ulkoavaruuden oliot ovat hallinneet maailmaa lähes kymmenen vuotta, kapinallisten ryhmä Chicagossa käy taisteluun planeettamme puolesta muukalaisia ja heidän ihmiskätyreitään vastaan. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Renegades
programme.desc: Navy SEAL-tiimillä on tehtävä sodanruntelemassa Sarajevossa, ja he päättävät toimia vastoin käskyjä. He päättävät etsiä mereen kätketyn aarteen, joka on piilotettu toisen maailmansodan aikaan. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2017.

programme.title: Deadfall
programme.desc: Sisarukset Addison (Eric Bana) ja Liza (Olivia Wilde) ovat pakomatkalla ryöstettyään Casinon. Toisaalla entinen nyrkkeilijä Jay (Charlie Hunnam) on matkalla kotiin vanhempiensa luo. Addison ja Liza pakenevat eri teitä kohti Kanadan rajaa kesken raivoisaa lumimyrskyä. Väkivaltainen Addison aiheuttaa paetessaan sekasortoa, kun Liza puolestaan liftaa Jayn kyydillä lähimpään kaupunkiin. Jayn vanhempien Junen (Sissy Spacek) ja Chetin (Kris Kristofferson) luona myrskyä paetessaan he ymmärtävät, että kohtalo on tuonut heidät yhteen. Amerikkalainen trilleri vuodelta 2012.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter Two
programme.desc: John Wick on täällä taas! Legendaarinen palkkamurhaaja on vetäytynyt kuvioista, mutta hänen on pakko hoitaa vielä yksi keikka Roomassa. Se ei kuitenkaan jää Wickin viimeiseksi, sillä yhtäkkiä koko palkkamurhaajien kilta kääntyy häntä vastaan, eikä hän voi luottaa keneenkään. Amerikkalainen toiminta vuodelta 2017.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Kapteeni Colter Stevenson (Jake Gyllenhaal) herää tuntemattoman miehen ruumiissa ja huomaa olevansa mukana pelastusoperaatiossa. Hänen tehtävänään on löytää lähijunan pommilla tuhonnut terroristi. Stevenson saa tietää joutuneensa osaksi hallituksen masinoimaa koetta, jossa testataan uutta teknologiaa nimeltä Source Code. Se on ohjelma, jonka avulla hänet voidaan siirtää toisen henkilön ruumiiseen tasan kahdeksan minuutin ajaksi ennen tämän kuolemaa. Toinen pommi uhkaa aiheuttaa tuhoa Chicagon keskustassa, joten Colterin on elettävä junaturman uhrin viimeiset minuutit yhä uudestaan ja uudestaan selvittääkseen pommittajan henkilöllisyys ja estääkseen seuraava isku. USA/Ranska toiminta 2011.

Jälleen kerran hän valmistautuu pitkään seikkailuun, joka tällä kertaa johdattaa hänet kauas Kiinaan. Yllätyksiä täynnä olevalla seikkailullaan kartografi tekee henkeäsalpaavia löytöjä, kohtaa ennennäkemättömiä olentoja, tapaa kiinalaisia prinsessoja sekä joutuu vastakkain taistelulajien mestareiden ja lopulta jopa suuren lohikäärmekuninkaan kanssa. Venäläinen toiminta vuodelta 2019.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: Ryhmä entisiä kasarivideopelimestareita on ihmiskunnan ainoa toivo torjua avaruusolioiden hyökkäys tässä visuaalisesti näyttävässä toimintaseikkailussa. Amerikkalainen komedia vuodelta 2015.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: Muistinmenetyksestä kärsivä Bourne on jättänyt väkivaltaisen menneisyyden taakseen ja elää tavallista elämää Marie-tyttöystävänsä kanssa. Suunnitelmat rauhallisesta elämästä romuttuvat, kun hän joutuu salamurhayrityksen kohteeksi. Amerikkalainen/ saksalainen toiminta vuodelta 2004.

programme.title: Den of Thieves
programme.desc: Nick, erikoisdivisioonan johtaja, saa selville tunnetun rikollisen suunnittelevan isoa ryöstöä. Päästäkseen askeleen edelle, Nick alkaa painostaa rikosliigaa saadakseen ilmiantajan. Amerikkalainen toimintaleffa vuodelta 2018.

programme.title: Clown in a Cornfield
programme.desc: Quinn ja hänen isänsä ovat muuttaneet hiljaiseen Kettle Springsin kaupunkiin aloittaakseen puhtaalta pöydältä. Vastassa on kuitenkin kovia kokenut hajonnut yhteisö. Kun paikalliset kinastelevat, ja jännitteet paisuvat, pahaenteinen hahmo ilmestyy maissipelloilta puhdistamaan kaupunkia rasitteistaan yksi verinen uhri kerrallaan. Todellinen hauskanpito alkaa, kun Frendo-klovni saapuu leikkimään. Amerikkalainen kauhuelokuva vuodelta 2025.

programme.desc: Celine Songin herkkä ja hienovarainen ohjausdebyytti Past Lives sai maailmanensi-iltansa Sundancen elokuvafestivaaleilla valloittaen sekä yleisön että kriitikoiden sydämet. Elokuvaa on ylistetty paitsi yhdeksi vuoden parhaista elokuvista, myös vaikuttavimmaksi rakkaustarinaksi vuosikausiin. Lapsuudenystävät Nora ja Hae Sung joutuvat eroon toisistaan, kun Noran perhe muuttaa pois Etelä-Koreasta. Kaksikymmentä vuotta myöhemmin he tapaavat New Yorkissa ja viettävät viikon yhdessä: onko olemassa ikiaikainen kohtalo, joka solmii sieluja yhteen? Past Lives on sydäntä särkevä moderni romanssi elämän risteyskohdista. Päärooleissa Norana ja Hae Sungina loistavat Greta Lee (Russian Doll, The Morning Show) ja Yoo Teo (Decision to Leave, Leto). Noran aviomiehenä Arthurina hienossa sivuroolissa nähdään John Magaro (Big Short). Romanttinen draama vuodelta 2023.

programme.title: The Fall Guy
programme.desc: Oscar®-ehdokas Ryan Gosling (Barbie) näyttelee Colt Seaversia, kovia kokenutta sijaisnäyttelijää, joka huolehtii fyysisestä ja henkisestä terveydestään lähdettyään alalta vuotta aiemmin. Hän joutuu takaisin töihin, kun hänen entinen tyttöystävänsä Jody Moreno, jota näyttelee Golden Globe -palkittu Emily Blunt (Oppenheimer), tarvitsee apua ohjaamansa suurelokuvan tähtinäyttelijän kadottua. Toimintakomedia vuodelta 2024.

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Elinikäiset ystävät Doug (Jack Black) ja Griff (Paul Rudd) ryhtyvät toteuttamaan unelmaansa uusintaa suosikkikulttiklassikkonsa Anakondan Amazonin syvyyksissä. Mutta asiat muuttuvat vakaviksi, kun todellinen jättiläisanakonda ilmaantuu, muuttaen heidän kaoottisen kuvauspaikkansa hengenvaaralliseksi. Elokuva, jonka he haluavat tehdä? programme.title: Sweet Autumn
programme.desc: Maggie, a successful entrepreneur, returns home for a will reading and discovers she’s inherited half of her aunt’s famed maple candy business. What she doesn’t understand is why Aunt Dee’s maple supplier, Dex, inherited the other half. Her return also coincides with the town’s Sweet Autumn Fest, and through a series of letters Aunt Dee left, Maggie and Dex search for the reason behind her aunt’s final wishes. As she and Dex grow closer, Maggie must decide if the life she built is the one she wants.

programme.title: Romantic Rewrite
programme.desc: Ivy is a talented up-and-coming romance book editor, up for a promotion at work but tasked with helping a stubborn mystery writer incorporate romance more successfully into the next book in his best-selling series. When he volunteers to be Ivy’s faux date for her best friend’s beach wedding in return for Ivy’s editing skills, will they be able to rewrite their fake romance into a real one?

programme.title: Here Kills the Bride
programme.desc: Inspired by the Highly Acclaimed Thriller - The Perfect Bride – Jessica is shocked to find out that her brother, Carlos, is getting married in a week to Grace, a girl he just met in a strip club, something he would never regularly do. Determined to find out the real reasons behind the marriage, Jessica gets pulled into a whirlwind of events, putting her own life at risk. Is Carlos in trouble? Or is Grace a victim?

programme.title: All for Love
programme.desc: When an engaged romance novelist is teamed with a Navy man as research for her latest book, she is taken aback by his boisterous personality and egotistical nature. However, as her research brings them closer together, she discovers there’s more to him than meets the eye. Will she choose the man she thought she loved or the real-life embodiment of her fictional hero?

programme.title: Romance Retreat
programme.desc: After a big breakup, journalist Dana Willingham finds herself alone and stuck at a couple’s yoga retreat while the biggest story of her career breaks far away. And she doesn’t even like yoga! But maybe the universe has put her here for a reason, because the handsome loner staying at the lodge turns out to be Stefan Gonzales, the tech guru at the center of the scandal. As she gains his trust to expose him, she finds herself falling in love with him. Now she must use the lessons from yoga to choose: the perfect story or the perfect man?

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: My Birthday Romance
programme.desc: Callie Fitzgerald is tired of her family fixing her up and questioning her single status. She is determined to find a pretend boyfriend for her 35th birthday party just so her family will leave her alone. What she didn’t expect was to actually fall for him.

programme.title: A Snapshot of Forever
programme.desc: After leaving her big city life behind, wedding photographer Jessie Brookes is happier than ever. When famous actor Nate Brown shows up on her parent’s vineyard for his sister’s wedding, she quickly realizes that there is more to him than meets the eye.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl. With a little nudging from the matchmaking daughter, Sophie and Michael unexpectedly start to fall in love and Sophie must decide between returning home or following her heart.

programme.title: A Country Romance
programme.desc: When Sarah Kress learns her family’s vineyard is up for sale, she leaves her busy urban life and visits her hometown to help with the sale and have her last harvest. With the help of handsome neighbor Gabe, huge challenge becomes fun as she and Gabe fall in love. But when the job is done, Sarah must decide whether to return to her fast-paced life or follow her heart.

programme.title: Our Take on Love
programme.desc: When unlucky-in-love Isabella and filmmaker Blake find themselves planning a huge celebration in a mansion where the most famous romance of all time blossomed, neither knew what they’d find. But as Isabella designs the signature dress and Blake films the story of the anniversary gala, they’re paired together to live and learn firsthand about the legendary, rich love story around them…they unexpectedly find a love and adventure they never knew could be true.

programme.title: Kiss the Cook
programme.desc: When Kacey Cooke, food blogger extraordinaire, with an impressive following, is approached with the opportunity to write her own cookbook, she jumps at it… Only problem is, she isn’t actually a very good cook. With a little help from handsome chef, Gavin Sawyer, and just a dash of undeniable chemistry, they may just have the recipe for success.

programme.title: A Love to Remember
programme.desc: After a year of interacting exclusively online, Tenley, an eco-conscious horticulturist, finally works up the courage to meet her online crush, Jared. When Jared doesn’t show because of a bike accident, Tenley gets mistaken for his wife at the hospital. Soon, she’s forced to keep the lie up with Jared’s entire family and his annoyingly charming best friend, Everett in order to save Jared’s company... You’ve Got Mail meets While You Were Sleeping!

programme.title: Meet The Spartans
programme.desc: A spoof of 300 (2006) and many other movies, TV series/shows/commercials, video games and celebrities. King Leonidas of Sparta and his army of 12 go to war against Xerxes of Persia to fight to the death for Sparta's freedom. Contains mild sexual references and language.
